# Weekly report 2026-W41

Week of 5–11 October 2026. Two posts went live in the last 28 days — one on @kaatdo (6 October) and one on @rishtapatra (9 October) — and both have their 48-hour insights; neither has reached the 7-day window yet. @job_rez published nothing in the window.

## Summary

- @kaatdo: 1 post, reach 412, views 538, saves 17 (48 hours).
- @job_rez: 0 posts.

## @kaatdo

## Experiments

1. @kaatdo — Hypothesis: a carousel that walks through the six rules will be saved more than the single image. Test: keep the Saturday carousel slot on the six rules next week. Measure: saves at 7 days against this week's 17.

## For the CEO

2. @job_rez has published nothing yet; the first JobRez post is the one to watch next week.
